description: Connect BB to a Magpie gateway and see what your agents cost. The Magpie page shows estimated cost, tokens over time per agent, cache hit rate, subscription allowance with reset times, and a breakdown by model, agent, or day. Sync models puts Magpie models into the Pi, Codex, and Claude Code pickers, and you can route one thread or a whole provider through Magpie. Gateway keys stay on the BB server.
